title: Intent Identification (Multi-Table Support)
description: Schema for intent_identification.json — output of the intent-identifier-agent. Array of intent records (one per unique target table in mapping). For single-table mappings, array contains one element.

table_type.description: NonTransactional_SCD2 = entity-state tables with full SCD2 history (expire+insert). NonTransactional_SCD1 = entity-state tables with overwrite-in-place (upsert, no history). Transactional = append-only event/fact tables.

grain_description.description: Human-readable grain statement (e.g. 'One row per case_id per effective period')

primary_key_columns.description: Natural key column(s) for MERGE ON clause or uniqueness

partition_key_columns.description: Partition column(s) — 'active' for NonTransactional_SCD2, 'dw_lod_tmp' for NonTransactional_SCD1, 'dw_bus_dt' for Transactional typically

eff_date_source.description: How eff_start_date is determined for NonTransactional tables. 'none' for Transactional.

load_type.description: Day0 = full/historical/retrospective/backfill load (synonyms: 'full', 'Day 0', 'initial load', 'all records'). BAU = incremental/delta/daily load (synonyms: 'incremental', 'Day 1', 'daily', 'since last run', 'new records'). full_then_incremental = both day0 and day1 generated.

snapshot_mode.description: True if source provides a full snapshot of all active entities (absence from source = deletion/deactivation at source). False (default) if source is a delta feed (absence = unchanged). Resolution priority: 0.5 = cdc_type_hint from mapping Additional Context ('snapshot'→true, 'delta'→false); 1 = domain knowledge CDC type ('full_snapshot'→true); 2 = default false.

protegrity_de_mappings.description: Empty array if no crypto required

identification_source.description: Primary source that resolved the intent fields. intent_override = resolved from session/intent_overrides.json (Priority 0, highest). mapping_column = resolved from optional mapping Excel columns Target Table Type / Key Column (Priority 0.5). additional_context = load_type resolved from Additional Context column (Priority 1.5)

custom_write_strategy.description: Non-null only when domain knowledge MD contains explicit unambiguous custom write/CDC instructions. When set, standard TargetWriter/run_cdc is NOT used.

de_name.description: Protegrity Data Element name — regex-extracted from transformation logic, never guessed
